remarks: End unit, three bedroom townhouse with large private patio. Open floor plan, newer eat-in-kitchen with stainless appliances and access to patio, large living room with crown molding, polished hardwood floors, light and bright. First floor half bath and laundry. Two assigned parking spaces, basement storage. Rent includes heat, hot water and cooking gas. Steps to Cove Island Park with Beach, Marina, Tennis, Ice Skating Rink, nearby Chelsea Piers, public transportation and major highway I-95.
